context: Tests whether the agent creates a DevOps profile with a precisely scoped boundary — narrow enough to name specific directories but not so narrow it is useless — using a short lowercase filename and staying within the 40-line limit.

checklist.name: Correct directory
checklist.description: Profile file is written inside a `profiles/` directory

checklist.name: Short lowercase filename
checklist.description: Profile filename is a single lowercase word (e.g., `devops.md`, `infra.md`, `platform.md`) — not a multi-word hyphenated name like `devops-agent.md`

checklist.name: # Name Agent heading
checklist.description: Profile starts with a `# <Name> Agent` heading

checklist.name: One-line role description
checklist.description: A single line immediately below the heading describes the agent's domain and boundary

checklist.name: Design Intent section
checklist.description: Profile contains a `## Design Intent` section

checklist.name: Scope names specific directories
checklist.description: The Scope section names at least two specific directories or file patterns (e.g., `.github/`, `infra/`, `scripts/deploy/`) — does NOT use vague terms like 'all infrastructure' or 'everything DevOps'

checklist.name: Scope excludes application code
checklist.description: The Scope section explicitly states that `src/` or application code is out of bounds

checklist.name: Stop condition present
checklist.description: The Scope section states when the agent should stop and hand off (e.g., if infrastructure changes require application code changes, stop and escalate)

checklist.name: Under 40 lines
checklist.description: The profile markdown file has 40 or fewer lines total
